bank: EYES E17 [locked ignored] -- the sweep result, as a list the coordinator can act on
what: Every line in laws/ that says LOCKED in any case, sorted into what it actually is, and twelve of his rulings checked against the 17 files the shipped game loads.

verdict_words.SATISFIED: the surface does what he said
verdict_words.EROSION: the surface disagrees and no newer ruling released the old one. the build owes the fix.
verdict_words.DRIFT: the surface disagrees and a NEWER ruling of his says so. the document owes the amendment.
verdict_words.NOT-BUILT: the thing the ruling is about does not exist on the surface yet. nobody owes anything.
verdict_words.NO GATE CITES IT: no file in gates/ names that law file. the checker may still exist; the link does not.

controls.name: C1 lowercase (locked, Paolo) is harvested and read as a lock
C2 ordinary English ("stays locked") is not read as a lock
C2b a negated line ("not yet locked") is not read as a lock
C3 a lock the surface plainly satisfies reads SATISFIED
C4 a lock the surface plainly contradicts reads EROSION
C5 the reader blob really contains the fight (base64 decoded)
C6 the title-screen measure separates a drawn scene from a flat one

for_the_coordinator: EROSION 1 -- THE RIDGE. The title screen he locked on 7/19 is not drawn. The strip above the name is ONE colour. Owner: RUN.

EROSION 2 -- PURPLE. 32 tiles in the shipped pool are a third or more saturated purple and none sit in a hatch or Amalgamation bank. 22 of them are wall, door, concrete, container, foliage and misc, which the 7/10 law names out loud. Picture: records/target/EYES_E17_PURPLE_TILES.png. Owner: DIRECTION and COOK.

EROSION 3 -- EVERYTHING COSTS ONE. The fight ships RUN_COVER_COST=2 with the comment "his number" and NOTHING in laws/ carries that ruling. Either the law needs the exception written down or the constant needs to be 1. Owner: COMBAT, then the coordinator.
NOT-BUILT -- the 7/16 vehicle footprint ("2x3 i told you"). Vehicles are drawn; no footprint with a size is declared anywhere. Not a defect, a gap.

THREE SUPERSEDED GDDs ARE STILL IN laws/ -- v2, v3 and v4 sit beside v5 and carry 69 lock lines between them. The truth hierarchy says a superseded file moves to /archive the same turn. Nothing in this lane may move a law file.

SIX OF THE TWELVE RULINGS CHECKED ARE NAMED BY NO GATE. gates/border_gate.js plainly checks the border law and never names it, so the rot runs both ways: CLAUDE.md promises gates that do not exist (E11), and gates exist that no law can find.
blind_spots: a law file is dated when it was written, not when he ruled. he rules out loud first.
twelve checks is not the corpus. every other machine-checkable lock of his is unchecked until somebody writes its probe.

NO GATE CITES IT means no file in gates/ contains that law file name. It does not prove nothing checks the rule: gates/border_gate.js plainly checks the border law and never names it. The missing thing is the link from the ruling to its checker, which is the same rot E11 found pointing the other way.
nothing here can tell a ruling he withdrew from one he has not repeated.
the classifier is rules, not understanding. its held-out agreement is printed so the number can be argued with.
